sloka: कथयिष्यन्ति लोकेषु पुरुषाः कर्म कुत्सितम् ।सुनृशम्सम् अधर्मिष्ठम् तव शौण्डीर्य मानिनः ॥३-५३-८॥
transliteration: kathayiṣyanti lokeṣu puruṣāḥ karma kutsitam ।sunṛśamsam adharmiṣṭham tava śauṇḍīrya māninaḥ ॥3-53-8॥

translations.english: You consider yourself to be brave after committing such a cruel, despicable and unrighteous act for which people of the world will condemn you.
